name: phplumb
description: Fast code navigation for large PHP and Drupal codebases.

phplumb.server.path.description: Path of the phplumb binary. Empty uses the bundled binary.

phplumb.root.description: Folder of the PHP project, relative to the workspace folder, such as src/drupal. Only this folder is indexed. Empty uses the workspace folder.

phplumb.exclude.description: Glob patterns, relative to the project folder (phplumb.root), of paths not to index.

phplumb.diagnostics.enabled.description: Reports classes, functions, methods and constants that do not exist, in project code. Dependencies, such as vendor, are skipped.

phplumb.frameworks.drupal.description: Drupal support, such as types for services. auto turns it on when a composer.lock in the project folder or up to three directories below it requires drupal/core.

phplumb.frameworks.symfony.description: Symfony support. auto turns it on when a composer.lock in the project folder or up to three directories below it requires symfony/framework-bundle.

phplumb.trace.server.description: Traces the communication between VS Code and the phplumb server.
